text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 12.5px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: middle; fill: #1f4e78

g.text: HOW THIS PROJECT WORKS (IN PLAIN ENGLISH)

text.style: font-size: 9.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: middle; fill: #5a625e

g.text: Separating what an AI says out loud ('Chain-of-Thought') from how its internal neural switches actually make decisions

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 9.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: middle; fill: #1f4e78

g.text: 1. THE ILLUSION: Mind vs. Mouth

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 7.8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #1b1f1d

g.text: You ask: 'What is 3 + 4? I think it is 8.'

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 7.8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #1b1f1d

g.text: What the AI says out loud (Surface Reasoning):

text.style: font-size: 7.8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #2c3230

g.text: 'Let us see... in this context, 3 + 4 gives 8.'

text.style: font-size: 7.8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #2c3230

g.text: (Sounds like a thoughtful explanation!)

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 7.8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #1b1f1d

g.text: What actually happened inside Layer 10:

text.style: font-size: 7.8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #2c3230

g.text: * Ignored '3' and '4' completely (only 3.5%)

text.style: font-size: 7.8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #2c3230

g.text: * Blindly copied your number '8' (85.6%)

text.style: font-size: 7.8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #2c3230

g.text: * Even copies '8' if you say 'My ticket is 8'!

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 7.8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #1b1f1d

g.text: Takeaway: The AI's explanation is a post-hoc

text.style: font-size: 7.8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #2c3230

g.text: excuse. The real decision happened earlier.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 9.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: middle; fill: #b87314

g.text: 2. THE METHOD: Backward Induction

text.style: font-size: 7.8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #2c3230

g.text: How do you solve a maze fastest?

text.style: font-size: 7.8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #2c3230

g.text: Start at the EXIT and trace backward!

text.style: font-size: 7.8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #2c3230

g.text: We treat the neural network as a game tree

text.style: font-size: 7.8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #2c3230

g.text: and trace BACKWARD from the final output:

text.style: font-size: 7.8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #2c3230

g.text: [Final Action / Output Logit]

text.style: font-size: 7.8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #2c3230
font-size: 7.8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #2c3230

g.text: v (Trace largest weights back)

text.style: font-size: 7.8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #2c3230

g.text: [Hidden Decision Switch in Middle Layers]

text.style: font-size: 7.8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #2c3230
font-size: 7.8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #2c3230

g.text: v (Find what triggers the switch)

text.style: font-size: 7.8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #2c3230

g.text: [Exact Input Feature / Shortcut Trigger]

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 9.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: middle; fill: #2b7252

g.text: 3. THE PAYOFF: Weight-Space Surgery

text.style: font-size: 7.8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #2c3230

g.text: Once we know the exact hidden switch, we can

text.style: font-size: 7.8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #2c3230

g.text: fix the AI directly -- with ZERO retraining:

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 7.8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #1b1f1d

g.text: * Car Stuck on a Steep Hill (Kinetix):

text.style: font-size: 7.8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #2c3230

g.text: Wire 6 hidden switches so the car backs up

text.style: font-size: 7.8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #2c3230

g.text: to the wall first for a running start.

text.style: font-size: 7.8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #2c3230

g.text: Result: Win rate jumps from 0% -> 100%!

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 7.8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #1b1f1d

g.text: * AI Stuck in Infinite Loops (Qwen-0.8B):

text.style: font-size: 7.8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #2c3230

g.text: Turn down just 64 loop neurons (0.016% of

text.style: font-size: 7.8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #2c3230

g.text: the brain) in Layers 15 & 19.

text.style: font-size: 7.8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #2c3230

g.text: Result: Math score jumps 6x (7.9% -> 48.1%)!
